st: How Do You Know If You're in Love?
d: The newly married couples return from their honeymoon and move into their new homes together  the couples are questioned by Pastor Cal.
The newlyweds meet with their friends and families for the first time since the weddings  one bride comes face to face with a stranger who will change her life.
The married strangers explore the potential to fall in love in the real world  some couples are falling in love, but others are not so sure.

t: BlackLove: Making Lemonade Out of Lemons
d: Tennesha and Errol decide to become exclusive  Laree just isn't ready to tell Karl she loves him  Cynthia finds it hard to venture out on her own  Monet finally finds peace in her divorce.
